#### 1. medium chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.398)

MED12 mutations in FG syndrome 1 disrupt general transcription regulation, leading to phenotypes like intellectual disability. ACADM mutations in MCADD impair fatty acid beta-oxidation, causing accumulation of medium-chain acyl-CoAs and leading to hypoketotic hypoglycemia and cardiomyopathy. Both disrupted transcription regulation and impaired fatty acid metabolism can converge on downstream cellular processes that contribute to the observed neurological and cardiac phenotypes.

**How to falsify it:** Absence of significant overlap in clinical presentation, specifically the lack of neurological or cardiac symptoms in patients with genetically confirmed FG syndrome 1 or MCADD, respectively. _(variant: rs12345678)_
